description: Change the pixel aspect ratio of the active sequence, or return a capability error when the legacy host does not expose a writable setting.

ratio.description: Pixel aspect ratio string (for example '1.0' for square pixels or '1.4222' for 16:9 DV).

name: set_sequence_pixel_aspect_ratio

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.
